panels.title: Total / Raw Written
panels.description: Raw bytes written over the selected range, excluding batch candle rewrites; includes streaming chart writes. Other overwritten files count each write.

targets.expr: (sum(sum_over_time({job_name_from_file=~".+"} | json | event=~"fetch_success|file_written" | data_type!="candles" | unwrap byte_count [$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(sum_over_time({job_name_from_file="market_streams"} | json | event="stream_bytes_written" | dataset_type=~"level_one|order_book|chart_stream" | unwrap delta_bytes [$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Total / Raw Converted
panels.description: Raw input bytes read by successful Tractatus publication groups over the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service="tractatus"} | json | event="group_committed" | unwrap input_bytes | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Total / Parquet Written
panels.description: Cache Parquet bytes from successful Tractatus group publication events over the selected time range. Missing cache measurements are unavailable.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service="tractatus"} | json | event="group_committed" | unwrap cache_bytes | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Total / Ratio
panels.description: Raw input bytes divided by cache Parquet bytes for the same publication groups with measured positive cache bytes. Groups without cache measurements are excluded.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service="tractatus"} | json | event="group_committed" | cache_bytes > 0 | __error__="" | unwrap input_bytes | __error__="" [$__range])) / sum(sum_over_time({service="tractatus"} | json | event="group_committed" | cache_bytes > 0 | __error__="" | unwrap cache_bytes | __error__="" [$__range]))
